title: Final Simulation: The Detour
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Count paths from the top-left cell (1,1) to the bottom-right
cell (n,n) of an n×n grid, moving only right or down, never stepping on a
blocked cell. Count modulo 10^9 + 7.

**Constraints:** 2 ≤ n ≤ 2000; 0 ≤ b ≤ 2000 blocked cells; blocked cells
never include (1,1) or (n,n).

**Input:** line 1: n, b; then b lines: r, c (row, then column — 1-based).
**Output:** one integer — the number of paths modulo 10^9 + 7.

tests.name: sample
tests.hint: The two blocks sit on the anti-diagonal: only the border-hugging paths survive — DDDRRR, DDRDRR, RRDRDD, RRRDDD → 4. (The all-clear grid has C(6,3)=20.)

tests.name: no blocks 2x2
blocked exit
tests.hint: Both neighbors of the start are blocked → 0.

tests.name: row trap
asymmetric blocks
tests.hint: Row-major dp: row1 = 1,1,1; row2 = 0,1,0; row3 = 0,1,1 → 1. (A program that reads the cells transposed gets 3 here.)
